f50217844b8a18f5b43accd36649155cd121e831.LogDescription: Discover the location of the Northern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.
f50217844b8a18f5b43accd36649155cd121e831.QuestDescription: What could they be for? I can't get the thought out of my head!$B$BIt's driving me crazy --  that the rumors I have heard about the crystal pylons are all true. Call me gullible, but I'll usually believe anything people tell me.$B$BAnyway, I have heard that there is one of the crystal pylons fairly close. Somewhere in the north... Please locate it, $N. I just know they exist.

f5035ea35798be5540a0c1603ff199d1e4b67fa7.LogDescription: Bring 6 Northern Salmon to Hugh Glass at the Redwood Trading Post.
f5035ea35798be5540a0c1603ff199d1e4b67fa7.QuestDescription: Thank goodness you're back, Limpy! I worried that Griselda and I were going to be all alone.$B$BI'm cooking up some food here for us, but Griselda'll have none of it.$B$BShe's fond of the fish that live off the coast of the Eastwind Shore, to the east. Can't stand them myself, but she's always been a picky eater. Six good-sized fish ought to keep her happy for a while.$B$BNow, run... err... limp along, Joe. Wouldn't want to keep the girl waiting, would ya?

f5044e800dd8a0361d318f10f639e53235467c62.Text: There goes the finest $c I have the honor of knowing.

f50663c11df0c69ff53da9bc88e3da2d55437d6a.LogDescription: Deathguard Molder at Venomspite has asked you to retrieve 6 Siegesmith Bombs.
f50663c11df0c69ff53da9bc88e3da2d55437d6a.QuestDescription: I'm tasked with the destruction of the Scarlet Onslaught's ballistae. Unfortunately, the apothecaries and I are at odds on the use of our resources, so I've nothing to destroy them with!$B$BTo the northeast are the Carrion Fields. The Scourge siegesmiths there at their forge and meat wagons are demolition masters.$B$BLuckily for us, they also leave their bombs lying about. $B$BI want you to retrieve them for me, off of the ground or the siegesmiths, I don't care which.

f5082a32a26c038fa01f77dd692f06813be12a56.comment: Cyclok the Mad - In Combat - Cast 'Arcane Explosion'

f508e0abf1cd6f0c71f54746c2ab7ad268a038e3.comment: Overlord Ramtusk - In Combat - Cast Thunderclap

f50a09192fc6d390084e277ef732a94525f8c716.RewardText: Revenge has a sweet taste, don't you think? When you destroyed the Agamands, did you catch any hint of free will within them? I hope so. I hope they knew fear before they were smashed into oblivion.$b$bIt is a foolish hope, I know. But it is a hope I foster nonetheless.

f50c5b731badaa5ecf91e04f0602982781079813.comment: Dormant Infernal - On Reset - Cast 'Stationary Infernal Ball' (No Repeat)

f50db48292d85ab873ea2f0334d6acde37adccd7.Text: Argh. They told me those crystals would work properly!

f50e0baf2d8b074fdc76651140f7e69ffdee193e.LogDescription: Bring Blacksting's Stinger to Reavij at Swamprat Post.
f50e0baf2d8b074fdc76651140f7e69ffdee193e.LogTitle: Nothin' Says Lovin' Like a Big Stinger
f50e0baf2d8b074fdc76651140f7e69ffdee193e.QuestDescription: She will be mine. Oh yes - she will be mine.$B$BIsn't Magasha the most beautiful troll you've ever seen? I have to find a way to win her heart. Sure, she has her eye on Zurai, but that is about to change. My foolproof plan will see to that.$B$BAll I need is a way to demonstrate my superior hunting skills, and that's where you come in my friend. There's a gigantic bog wasp known as Blacksting that roams the area south of the glowing draenei towers to the west. Bring me its stinger and I'll work my magic.

f5146922bb32186fb6b8e2c97d2b5f6cc58f9c05.Text: I will use the power of the ata'mal crystal to crush you!

f51b92691fc95436763286f89d825ec9f9fa7bbd.Text: No, I was right to begin with. Deatholme must come last. We must secure all of the Ghostlands first. I will not commit the forces here to a battle against Dar'khan with enemies to our flank and rear!

f51e2223396a0fde7c35826e226f6078e65df98a.LogDescription: Speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.
f51e2223396a0fde7c35826e226f6078e65df98a.QuestDescription: Excuse me, friend...$B$BIt has come to my attention that Turak Runetotem has put out word that he wishes to speak with you.  It seems that your training as a druid is about to take on a new life, and he will be training you personally.  Turak is one of the Arch Druid's assistants; he is known as a wise and patient druid, and he should teach you well.$B$BHe is located in Thunder Bluff, inside the Cenarion Circle's main tent on the Elder Rise.

f51e8f44a1e00abdfac9fcccc4c1bf1b53994a83.RewardText: Training against the other valiants will sharpen your claws and hone your battle insticts. When the competition begins, you will be ready.

f52246d9536ad7bd1dc7d4df81b2f8ead5c3eb64.CompletionText: Did you find the gizmonitor? I must have it before its energy supply runs out!

f524b297d1d7e64af62c9c8f5efa931634740229.LogDescription: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Smith Regzar in Frostwolf Village.
f524b297d1d7e64af62c9c8f5efa931634740229.QuestDescription: When you fight the enemy, gather the scraps of their armor and bring them to me.  I'll use those scraps to make armor for our own troops!

f524dd3038afbc866fdc992031f5357e55f25ffb.Text: The master's sanctum has been disturbed!

f52609fe7874e30a46073e5092e78f1defa3e2bf.Text: We don't take kindly to miscreants, $r.

f526295d307e7bcf818e2e925efb687fd1c31032.OptionText: What do you have for sale?

f526583ef25be7fc6c18fd8d9aaa08ad7c4299e8.Text: Uther had my troops recalled? Damn it! If my warriors abandon me, I'll never defeat Mal'Ganis. The ships must be burned before the men reach the shore!

f52722af1ad7c598b07c0b834ea4e36312a29650.Text: There is no escape for you.  The Crusade shall destroy all who carry the Scourge's taint.

f5329b5f3f4c19ea94f4e5b493dee507c2b187a9.comment: Zereketh The Unbound - On Death Say

f534005c32f7e5263bef43cad9036588e7f9fa74.LogDescription: Prigmon needs you to collect 10 Forest Troll Tusks from the trolls in Zul'Aman. Bring them to him at Budd's camp in the Ghostlands.
f534005c32f7e5263bef43cad9036588e7f9fa74.QuestDescription: 'Ey mon! You be new around 'ere, eh? Lemme ask a favor of ya.$b$bBudd's been refinin' his forest troll disguise. Says that he be close now - just be needin' one last touch. Tusks.$b$bMy skinnin' talents be wasted 'ere. Somethin' about yankin' troll tusks be makin me queasy. $b$bBring me back 10 troll tusks, eh mon?

f535148629a45b2c36d32e72f8234f526ba61350.LogDescription: Ground Commander Xutjja at the edge of the glacier north of Ymirheim has ordered you to use the Kor'kron Suppression Turret to keep the Kor'kron Troop Transport alive long enough to make all of its drops.
f535148629a45b2c36d32e72f8234f526ba61350.QuestDescription: Alright scrub, I've got something to keep you from being a complete waste.$B$BA unit of highly trained infiltrators is ready to be dropped inside of Ymirheim. The vrykul inside have automated spear guns that have been ripping our transports to shreds, so we had the engineers on Orgrim's Hammer whip us up a suppression turret.$B$BYou're the gunner. Launch rounds at their spear guns to obscure their vision and clog their gears. See to it that my men all make their drops and the transport stays in one piece.

f53771c5473ada1243515882302052c322e1b740.comment: East Stone - On Spell Hit - Give Quest Credit

f53ab52aba7140e981edc5afdaf43bdabfe521d1.comment: Engineer Whirleygig - On Aggro - Cast 'Compact Harvest Reaper' (Phase 1) (No Repeat)

f53e34e1112e059c14d11a22365ccb635352abef.RewardText: Good that the ethereal filth and their leader are dead. I wish a thousand plagues upon their brethren!$B$BYou are to be rewarded for you actions on behalf of all of the Mok'Nathal, $N! You are truly one of our heroes.$B$BLet us now release the souls of our ancestors to the cleansing fire.

f53f580c3fc28c2e439190d673d326ac13ec3fff.RewardText: At last!$B$B<Commander Ameer reads from the Mark of the Nexus-King.>$B$BTwo final prisons? I shudder to think what horrors lie in wait...

f54c8a261870790ec8da1bebfc5d3d3e64b0a36d.LogDescription: Slay Zorbo the Advisor, 5 Warmaul Shaman and 5 Warmaul Reavers. Return to Warden Bullrok if you manage to complete this task.
f54c8a261870790ec8da1bebfc5d3d3e64b0a36d.QuestDescription: Wanted: Dead or Alive$B$BZorbo the Advisor, wanted for numerous planned attacks on Garadar. Along with his reavers and shaman, Zorbo has slain countless orcs. Consider Zorbo as armed, dangerous, and merciless.$B$BZorbo makes his home in the Laughing Skull Ruins in the northern mountains of Nagrand.$B$BReward for Zorbo the Advisor's death or capture to be dispensed by Warden Bullrok at Garadar.

f54e5486a78c3a101fe1cc7a2a42d6f1b752d329.LogDescription: Huntress Bintook at Telaar in Nagrand wants you to speak to Mo'mor the Breaker.
f54e5486a78c3a101fe1cc7a2a42d6f1b752d329.QuestDescription: You must seek out Mo'mor immediately! You will find him in the center of Telaar, by the fountain. Tell him exactly what the ogre told you.

f553dbef624ca4f393cc15fa3a8f4b3af5e36fa8.LogDescription: Find Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.
f553dbef624ca4f393cc15fa3a8f4b3af5e36fa8.QuestDescription: Long has it been since you were last tested, $N. You have shown patience thus far in your studies, but the time has come for you to learn more. The time has come for you to learn about the purity of water.$B$BSeek out Islen Waterseer in the Barrens. She is along the eastern coast, south of the Southfury River and Ratchet. You will find her there at her fishing hut. Good luck to you, $N.

f559a3d611c88b04e4be9c79bc740997c6236a06.Text: Now, in Shattrath City: The Tauren Chieftains! Playing in the World's End Tavern at the top of the hour!

f55ecc2bacc0c5a0229386ed61b5ba2054f46b1c.comment: Chillwind Lieutenant - In Combat - Cast 'Frost Shock'

f55edbc9476a9d37d30e2089d4ba6bd63812954f.Text: Yea, that hit the spot.  Muffins for sale!  Get your fresh muffins right here!

f560ea462c897797d08eadd0b6914e3fe221d837.LogDescription: Escort "Stinky" Ignatz, then speak with Morgan Stern in Theramore.
f560ea462c897797d08eadd0b6914e3fe221d837.QuestDescription: Great, finally something that doesn't want to eat me!$B$BI need help handling the critters around here, and you fit the mold, $gbuddy:lady;.$B$BThe cook Morgan Stern is researching a new recipe, and he sent me out here to gather bogbean leaves.  I guess he thinks they're tasty.$B$BAnyway, while looking for a bogbean plant... I got myself surrounded!  Can you help me out of here, and watch my back as I look for the bogbean?

f563ee9ff9482a311dbbc9d2ee3373bca8e74e8a.LogDescription: Mountaineer Cobbleflint of the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts.
f563ee9ff9482a311dbbc9d2ee3373bca8e74e8a.LogTitle: In Defense of the King's Lands
f563ee9ff9482a311dbbc9d2ee3373bca8e74e8a.QuestDescription: We need to protect the Loch, $N!  With so many of the King's soldiers fighting valiantly on remote battlefields, we've become overwhelmed on the home front.  Troggs are tunneling up from every crevice!  The Trogg infestation poses the largest threat to Ironforge.  These disgusting mutants must be destroyed.$b$bWe need you, brave adventurer, to venture forth and lay waste to the Trogg threat.  Slay 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts and report back.

texts.text0_0: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

The other three items are all in Stromgarde.$B$BTake a rest an' get your strength back--the next phase of my plan'll require a little more time an' effort. Come back to me after you've gotten a warm meal an' some rest.

f57b8ce859f8db9dbdabd1d2263aec85a3c8f3fb.Text: Time for my patrol.  I'll be back shortly.

f57c12b72969e1798af31ae763afe5968eaeb78a.RewardText: Revenge feels good. To think that this is but a taste of what's to come.$b$bArthas will get what he deserves soon enough. Then and only then will I die a happy man.

texts.text0_0: You da boss now, yeah?  Long live da new king!$B$BKreeg let you look at Gordok hooch.  Ogre hooch best of all hooch, and Gordok hooch best of all ogre hooch!  Maybe you buy some from me, ya boss?!

f581f2ab53d4f33af0a26684b368d9b671fffb56.RewardText: These will do perfectly, $N. Take this piece of armor as a reward. I'll be able to make more with the pelts you brought me.

f582119747b9ccc79ba7bd3cf7e7e0175333c04b.RewardText: $N, I give you my warmest thanks for the aid you've given us.  Your bravery in the face of overwhelming odds has warranted a reward worth a thousand times greater.  Nevertheless, I hope you accept this on behalf of the entire Stronghold.$B$BNow, if I may... I'd like to ask for your aid one more time.  In light of the discovery of the Zukk'ash hive here in Feralas, I think you're the best choice for this mission.

f58cc0fb9fcb4f9b54d618ec5e8c70aefcd3957b.Text: I knew this was a dragonforged blade when I first laid eyes on it.

f5974ef5c4dc546e69cb052e2f48280a37ea90c5.LogDescription: Slay 10 Deathless Watchers, 4 Fearsome Horrors, and 2 Putrid Wights. Afterward, inform Greatmother Ankha at Camp Winterhoof of your success.
f5974ef5c4dc546e69cb052e2f48280a37ea90c5.QuestDescription: Your assistance to us has been tremendous, $N, but there is something that is troubling me: these so-called Scourge.$B$BThe spirits of the land and air, the waters and the fire below the world, would not abide their presence, but seem to do nothing about them. We will see to it that they are dealt with!$B$BPerhaps it is asking too much, but I would have you return west to Gjalerbron and destroy the unnatural Scourge in that vile lair. Be sure to check in the Waking Halls below Gjalerbron as well!

f59887b609c46b7f5de96d1001ca0b1748425321.comment: Dark Rune Stormcaller - In Combat - Cast 'Shadow Word: Pain' (Normal Dungeon)

f59f2723808a8edee31ff7a88e3fa3d745a6bf28.LogDescription: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
f59f2723808a8edee31ff7a88e3fa3d745a6bf28.QuestDescription: $N, I have been following your progress with much delight.  You are most assuredly developing yourself into a valued protector of nature.$B$BThe time has come for you to learn more about one of the various animal aspects that Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to change into - one that affords you command and mastery of the water.  For this, you must travel to the village of Nighthaven in Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle there.  He will guide you further.

f5aa947d0a7a9f8d546cd4bb13ad52c15e8b2b0d.RewardText: Ah, thank you, $N. Using the items you brought me, I will be able to create the remedy I need to stop the spread of the infection and, eventually, cure it completely. I owe you my life in thanks.$b$bBut I'll never forget that screeching call when Mazzranache came upon me, the blaze of color as its beak descended...$b$bBe wary on your travels.

f5b5d9430e95201bd72d0586f081b79d940d91e6.LogDescription: Deliver the Slightly Creased Note to Elenia Haydon near the bank in the Undercity.
f5b5d9430e95201bd72d0586f081b79d940d91e6.QuestDescription: She was so sad. I could see that, once I saw past her state. I mean, she seemed sad - wouldn't you?$b$bBut after talking to her, there was a connection. I didn't think anyone could understand what I was thinking, but she could.$b$bWhen I told the others, they laughed at me, so I never spoke with her again. But I miss her. Can you take this letter to her for me? I want to be sure it finds her hands.

f5b62e11656ff5ba6f74b504a29f53f122e6eeb3.LogDescription: Search the outer ring of Ironforge for John Turner.
f5b62e11656ff5ba6f74b504a29f53f122e6eeb3.QuestDescription: Your task then, $N, is to find someone here in Ironforge that is in need of aid. Someone who is pure of heart and motive. Perhaps someone helping others. Perhaps someone in need of a guide. Regardless, the person must have noble intent and be relying on your kindness.$B$BDo this, and return to me when you are finished. Then, we shall discuss more of your path and what it means to be a paladin of the Light. I will remain here in the temple for your return. Other paladins will need my guidance also.

f5bbf337bc968d7685f44c0207e6ea291f14c2b8.LogDescription: Corporal Maga at the Altar of Sseratus wants you to kill any combination of 10 Champions of Sseratus, Priests of Sseratus, or Drakkari Snake Handlers.
f5bbf337bc968d7685f44c0207e6ea291f14c2b8.QuestDescription: I couldn't help but overhear what you were talking to the sergeant about. That doesn't change the fact that we still have a job to do here.$B$BWhile you're out there, do you think you could help us to put some of those followers of Sseratus out of their misery?

f5bf9c595fc65fcca462dd4c35043b6f60d5ddd5.RewardText: It means very much to us that you come to aid us in our time of need.  We'll not easily forget you nor he who sends you.$B$BYou have our thanks.

f5f7eff9d2f2eda9059f257c13f4e376778f37b0.LogDescription: Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch wants you to destroy the Metal Stake imprisoning Patches in the Sanctum of Reanimation and help him get his revenge on Doctor Sabnok.
f5f7eff9d2f2eda9059f257c13f4e376778f37b0.QuestDescription: So they've been embedding these ghouls with broken shards of saronite down in the Sanctum of Reanimation? We must put a stop to this, before these ghouls can be deployed against our troops.$B$BFind the entrance to the Sanctum of Reanimation in the flesh giant lab area of the Fleshwerks. There, the ghoul mastermind, Doctor Sabnok, keeps the most fearsome of his creations, Patches. Free Patches from his chains and help him take his revenge on the doctor. Let his own creation be his undoing.

f5fca2aa15619dfb539decde6295e42566ae8bcb.LogDescription: Seek out the Great Bear Spirit in northwestern Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the bear.  When finished, return to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
f5fca2aa15619dfb539decde6295e42566ae8bcb.QuestDescription: In the northwest part of Moonglade resides the home of a wise and noble being we call the Great Bear Spirit.  For all druids, it has served as a tutor and mentor into the first true natural understanding of the bear.  All druids at one point seek the spirit's wisdom, and you shall be no exception.$B$BGo to the Great Bear Spirit now and learn what it will teach.  When it is satisfied with you, return to me here in Nighthaven.  We will then see if you have truly taken account of the lessons it teaches.
